action.command: bad=$(grep -rnE '\[0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}, *0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}, *0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}\]' src-tauri/src --include='*.rs' | grep -v 'src-tauri/src/theme.rs'); if [ -n "$bad" ]; then echo "$bad"; echo 'Hardcoded palette colour outside theme.rs: define the colour in src-tauri/src/theme.rs (AGENTS.md conventions)'; exit 1; fi

bad=$(grep -rnE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\b' src/lib --include='*.svelte' --include='*.css' --include='*.ts' | grep -vE 'src/lib/crypte\.css|src/lib/space/space\.css|src/lib/contracts\.ts|src/lib/space/types\.ts|src/lib/screens/HauntView\.svelte|src/lib/chat/FxOverlay\.svelte|\.test\.ts' | grep -vE '^[^:]+:[0-9]+: *(\*|//)'); if [ -n "$bad" ]; then echo "$bad"; echo 'Hardcoded colour outside the palette: use the --cry-* variables (src/lib/crypte.css) or the --space-* variables (src/lib/space/space.css)'; exit 1; fi
